content.text: With 80% of Wales' landscape managed by farmers, the government contended that these farmers have a crucial part to contribute in addressing climate change and the decline in natural ecosystems.

Roundtable discussions have been conducted by the Welsh government with leaders in farming, along with environmentalists and nature advocates, aimed at revising the plan intended to ensure sustainable farming practices and achieve climate and nature objectives by 2030.

NFU Cymru president Aled Jones: 'The SFS must work for all farming sectors and areas of Wales and help ensure that Welsh farming can continue to underpin the £9.3bn food and farming supply chain,' he said.
